title: Fortnite This Week: Two New Captains
caption:
#EpicPartner Everything that changed in Fortnite this week. Use code BAD in the Item Shop.
#Fortnite #FortniteNews

claims.text: Map 17 -> 16 places; removed ['Boogie Boat', "Fortune's Fort", 'Loot Lagoon']; added ["Nami's Tangerine Grove", "Buggy's Beachhead"]
